title: A Multi-Opinion Based Method for Quantifying Polarization on Social Networks
reasoning: The paper focuses on proposing a quantitative metric to measure opinion polarization in social networks. While the topics it analyzes as case studies (e.g., political issues, medical treatments) can have moral or ethical dimensions for the public, the paper's methodology does not evaluate or benchmark these ethical or moral standpoints. Its contribution is purely a structural and mathematical analysis of disagreement patterns.
